title: Frontier record: the single authoritative accepted result, or a table of them

evidence_level.description: Every level that applies; not a ladder.

claim_kind.description: What kind of claim the statement is, and so what a check of it can establish (spec §5). Every kind that applies.

external.description: Outside authorities that keep this field's records and accepted the result (evidence level `externally-accepted`).

authority.description: Who keeps the record: a records table, archive or catalogue.

url.description: Where the authority shows the accepted result.

ref.description: The authority's identifier for it, if any.

bound.description: The best proven bound on the other side, exact representation: no value can beat it. When the value meets it, the question is settled.

bound_source.description: Where the bound is proved: a path, DOI or URL.

unit.description: Unit shown beside the value, if any.

history.description: Path of the frontier's history: JSON Lines (or a JSON array), one entry per change, {date, value, statement, bound, case, formulation, by, source, note} (spec §5). Without it the hub derives a history from the record's git history.

table.description: A frontier made of many independent cases, one row each (spec §5, record tables). `statement` describes the family.

path.description: The table file, from the repo root.

format.description: Default: from the extension. JSON is an array of objects, or an object with a `rows` array.

key.description: Columns that identify a case, e.g. ["v", "k", "t"]; unique per row.

value.description: Column holding the case's best value so far.

bound.description: Column holding the best proven bound on the other side, where known. A row is open while it has no bound or its value doesn't meet it.

object.description: Column holding the path of the case's witness, the object a check recomputes.

check_row.description: Argv that checks one row, run from the repo root; {column} is replaced by the row's value in that column.

check_row_minutes.description: Expected runtime of check_row on a typical row.

by.description: Column crediting who found the case's current value.

source.description: Column with where it came from: a PR (#123), a commit, or a URL.

updated.description: Column with the date (YYYY-MM-DD) the case's value last changed.

formulation.description: The exact problem the record answers (spec §5, Formulations). A changed model, objective or constraint set is a new formulation: its results start a new series and aren't compared with the old one's.

id.description: Short name, changed whenever the problem changes, e.g. "truss-25-grouped-v1".

replaces.description: The formulation this one changed, and so isn't comparable with.

suite.description: A frontier that is a method, scored on held-out instances against named baselines (spec §5, Evaluation suites). `statement` says what the method achieves and against what.

path.description: Results file, one row per run: method, instance, value, and optionally seed, machine, draw, by, source.

current.description: The accepted method: the one the statement is about.

method.description: Its name in the results file.

strength.description: starter: the project's own first implementation. published: a method from the literature, as implemented here. mature: an established solver the field relies on (a CP-SAT, a tuned tabu search, a commercial optimizer).

draw.description: fixed: a public, frozen set (methods may have been tuned to it). drawn: generated from randomness fixed after the method was, e.g. a public beacon round later than the method's commit. sealed: held privately by the maintainers and run by them, published after each round.

generator.description: Argv that generates instances; {seed} and {count} are replaced.

beacon.description: drawn: the public randomness source, e.g. "drand-quicknet"; results name the round in `draw`.

dev.description: A public development set to tune on, kept apart from the held-out instances.

budget.description: What each run may spend. Prefer a unit that doesn't depend on the machine (evaluations, feasibility checks, nodes); with a time unit, results carry `machine` and runs pair only within one.

evaluate.description: Argv that runs one method on a draw and prints result rows; {method} and {draw} are replaced.

scope.description: Conditions under which the statement holds.

assumptions.description: Open obligations the statement depends on.

sources.description: PR numbers, commits or URLs the result is assembled from.

reproduce.description: Command that checks the result from a clean checkout; may be incremental on hash-identified, verified predecessors.

reproduce_full.description: Full replay from scratch, when it differs from `reproduce`.

reproduce_minutes.description: Expected runtime of `reproduce` on an ordinary machine.

prerequisites.description: What a newcomer must install before `reproduce` runs.

review.description: Path or URL of the maintainer review.
